rows.body: Everhome Suites is Choice's midscale extended-stay brand—introduced in 2020 as the first new core midscale brand in nearly a decade. U.S. development is the primary growth story in published materials today; CALA owners should confirm market authorization with Choice development before underwriting. Evaluate fit on weekly-stay demand, prototype scope, professional third-party management capability, and net contribution after fees—not generic upscale or economy assumptions.
Everhome Suites: midscale extended-stay · U.S.-led development momentum · Choice Privileges distribution

rows.title: Americas
rows.body:
Primary growth market

North America carries Everhome's open and pipeline inventory—suburban and employment-corridor extended-stay with in-suite kitchens, Homebase Market, and outdoor living amenities. Choice development materials cite multiple recent U.S. openings (Texas, Florida, New Jersey, California, and others) and 65+ properties under development; owner conversations center on weekly-stay economics versus MainStay and Suburban, not upscale full-service conversion.

rows.title: CALA
rows.body:
Confirm with Choice CALA

Published Everhome momentum is U.S.-led today—no census-backed open inventory in CALA yet. If you are developing extended-stay in the region, engage Choice CALA on territory authorization, prototype importability, and local weekly-stay comps. MainStay and Suburban remain relevant Choice extended-stay options where Everhome timing differs; Everhome is still worth screening where midscale kitchens, Homebase Market, and third-party management align with your market.

rows.title: Europe
rows.body:
Limited direct relevance

Everhome is positioned in Choice materials as a U.S. midscale extended-stay growth brand—useful for Choice Hotels corporate scale context, not a European greenfield template for this flag.

rows.title: MEA
rows.body:
Limited direct relevance

No material Everhome open inventory in MEA on published development paths—domestic U.S. ramp and prototype economics should drive feasibility.

rows.title: APAC

Limited direct relevance

Thin-to-no Everhome presence in APAC on published development paths; U.S. weekly-stay demand and census-backed counts should anchor owner underwriting—not APAC network density.

Everhome growth is prototype- and pipeline-led: Choice's extended-stay team includes 70+ dedicated experts with multiple properties open and 65+ under development (Choice brand materials). The brand targets higher-barrier markets with strong extended-stay demand—owners win when weekly-stay mix, kitchen operations, and Homebase ancillary revenue align with local supply, not when the deal needs nightly transient or upscale F&B depth.

Introduced in 2020; first Everhome opened in Corona, CA. Choice materials describe significant U.S. pipeline momentum with ready-to-build prototypes typically delivering in 10–12 months—underwrite from local extended-stay comps and your pro forma, not system averages.
Midscale extended-stay within Choice portfolio · compare to MainStay Suites (mature) and Suburban Studios (economy extended) on fee stack and prototype fit

Everhome reads as “fresh midscale extended-stay with U.S. pipeline momentum”: credible for employment-corridor and suburban owner stories where kitchens, ~15-night guest profiles, and Choice Privileges matter more than resort amenity depth or upscale F&B. It tends to show best where operators can execute weekly billing and professional management—not where the deal needs gateway luxury or economy kitchenette-only product.
